general_information.Syllabus Name: Understanding Language Testing_Phương pháp đánh giá năng lực ngôn ngữ
general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Student-centered approach: - Giving presentations - Analyzing tests and other forms of assessment - Designing test - Defending their designed tests - Reviewing other tests - Applying AI tools in optimizing test design
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 105 hours self-study (including assessments, projects and assignments preparation time)
general_information.Pre-Requisite: Passed ESL101/ESL301, ELT401/ELT402, ELI401/ELI402, ERW421/ERW422/ERW423, EOB301
general_information.Description: Objectives: The course is designed to help students have the essential foundation of stones of language assessment with ample practical examples to illustrate application in language. Students will be able to develop assessment literacy by understanding, addressing issues and applying concepts. Description: The course introduces students to fundamental principles and tools for language assessment. Concepts are presented with practical, understandable explanations and concise references to supportive research. Students are able to recognize different forms of testing and assessment and are equipped to design and evaluate practical, effective assessment techniques to apply them to classroom contexts. Teaching Methods: The teaching process includes various methods: - Lecture the lessons and exercises varied from individuals, pair or group work, whole-class discussion. - Guide students' learning with research, self-study with feedback. - Have interactive discussions of questions and issues that may arise during lessons. - Manage group work and enhance their interests in testing and assessments throughout the course. Assessment scheme: 1) On-going assessment: 100% - Presentation: 10% - Progress test: 10% - Assignment 1: 50% - Assignment 2: 15% - Assignment 3: 15% 2) Final Result: 100% 3) Completion Criteria: a) On-going assessment >0, Each component >0 b) Final Result >=5
general_information.StudentTasks: Attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. Be responsible to do all exercises, and assignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. Participate actively in class discussions. Read the textbook in advance. Use laptops in class only for learning purposes.
general_information.Tools: Textbook, Teacher's Book, pptx, handouts, Internet, AI tools (ChatGPT, Google AI Studio, Elevenlabs, Twee, Edpuzzle...)

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand assessment concepts and issues and their application in different contexts.
Understand principles of language assessment and apply each principle to classroom-based assessment instruments.
Design and analyze classroom language tests and apply AI-assisted tools in designing tests where applicable.
Understand standards-based assessment and apply principles of standardization to the construction of teacher-based standards.
Develop a standardized test and apply AI-assisted tools in designing a standardized test where applicable.
Design language skills assessments, including listening, speaking, reading, and writing; grammar and vocabulary assessments; apply AI-tools where applicable.
Develop scoring rubrics for assessments to assess test-takers' performance and provide feedback
Defend their designed tests and review other groups' designed tests
Assure the consideration of the ethnics of testing in an educational and commercial world driven by tests and respect in group work.
Practice lifelong learning and collaborative skills through AI-enhanced group work environments
